data.title: Keeping the Scale Balanced
data.description: Explore how changing both sides of a balance scale affects equality and figure out the mystery quantity in each equation.

challenges.instruction: Find the mystery number that makes both sides balance.
challenges.hint: Remove the 6 block from both sides. What is left on each side?
